# CineDoc AI

> CineDoc AI is an AI-assisted video production studio for cinematic documentaries and Kids & Family stories.

## Public pages

- Home and production studio: /
- About the platform: /about
- Frequently asked questions: /faq
- Terms and Conditions: /terms
- Privacy Policy: /privacy

## Core capabilities

- Generate scene-based scripts from a topic or custom narration.
- Choose cinematic documentary or Kids & Family formats: educational, entertainment, adventure, and bedtime.
- Generate audience-aware visuals and independent documentary/kids narration profiles.
- Select whether synchronized subtitles are burned into the final video.
- Review scenes, replace images, edit narration, adjust timing, and rerender.
- Credits are reserved during processing and deducted after a validated successful render.

## Supported narration providers

- Microsoft Neural voices
- Sarvam AI Bulbul voices
- OpenRouter speech models
- Cloudflare speech providers

## Showcase formats

- Landscape 16:9
- Instagram Reels 9:16
- TikTok 9:16

## Access notes

- Public documentation pages may be indexed.
- Admin, authentication, generated user media, and API routes are private or operational surfaces.
